style.backgroundSystem: alternating systems held to one material language: a matte 3D-rendered display stage (two-tier organic podium #B7D6D1 with one inset hairline trim line #C9A961, a blush-pink side wall #E6CFCB meeting a sage-green back wall #86ADA8 at a vertical seam, stepped blocks and small geometric ornaments) for hero and companion screens, and flat sage-green #86ADA8 or clean #FFFFFF infographic screens carrying rounded cards with 16px corner radius for the copy-led screens
style.iconSystem: solid capsule badge bars #86ADA8 holding #FFFFFF labels, thin dotted circular medallions framing the product, small numbered chips, rounded-rectangle card grids with a solid label band beneath each image, hairline rules and podium inlay in #C9A961; no medical or veterinary pictograms
style.lightingSystem: soft diffused studio key from the front-left at 5500K with a large bounce fill, gentle gradient falloff, matte non-specular surfaces, soft contact shadows only so nothing floats; the single home scene uses natural window light from the left at 5200K
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium pastel 3D-stage pet-care ecommerce visual system across the entire detail-page image set; fixed palette of sage-green panel #86ADA8, pale sage podium #B7D6D1, blush-pink wall #E6CFCB, light-stone counter #EDE8E3 and clean field #FFFFFF, with one metallic hairline accent #C9A961 and deep green-slate text #2F5D59; cool-neutral tone; modern geometric sans-serif with one headline weight per screen, a letter-spaced latin kicker above each Chinese headline and solid capsule sub-badges; background system alternating a matte 3D-rendered display stage (two-tier organic podium #B7D6D1 with one inset hairline trim #C9A961, sage back wall #86ADA8 meeting blush side wall #E6CFCB at a vertical seam, stepped blocks and small geometric ornaments) and flat sage #86ADA8 or clean #FFFFFF infographic screens carrying rounded cards with 16px corner radius; soft diffused studio key from the front-left at 5500K with a large bounce fill, gentle falloff, matte non-specular surfaces and soft contact shadows only; single-family thin-line infographic components of dotted circular medallions, numbered chips, capsule badges and card grids with solid label bands; the upright container held at the same slight 3/4 hero angle and scale with its label print true to the reference; 2:3 mobile detail-page slice; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no medical or veterinary iconography, no glossy hyper-real plastic render drift.
noDrift: no medical or veterinary iconography such as crosses, shields, organs or body diagrams
no QR codes, membership stickers or store badges
no glossy hyper-real plastic render drift
style.presentationRules: the upright container is held at the same slight 3/4 hero angle and the same scale on every screen, grounded by a soft contact shadow on the podium, its cap, rim, seam and wrap-around label true to the reference and never restyled; the pet companion is always cropped or turned so no individual animal identity dominates
style.surfaceSystem: matte two-tier podium #B7D6D1, blush shelf #E6CFCB, matte light-stone home counter #EDE8E3, glossy ceramic bowl #FFFFFF
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, one headline weight per screen; a letter-spaced latin kicker line sits above each Chinese headline; Chinese headline 30-44pt in #FFFFFF on sage screens and in #2F5D59 on light screens, solid capsule sub-badge 14-18pt, spec-row label 16pt; every rendered line is carried as a placeholder, never as source copy
